newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PCIBank unit gets higher credit rating.
newsitem.headline: PCIBank unit gets higher credit rating.

text.p: PCI Leasing and Finance Inc, a wholly-owned unit of PCIBank, said on Wednesday it received a higher credit rating of CIB 1 Minus from CIB 2 Plus from the Credit and Information Bureau Inc (CIBI), a local credit rating agency.
This is in connection with its license to issue up to 1.6 billion pesos of short-term commercial papers.
The CIBI makes an annual review of ratings of companies which have issued short-term and long-term commercial papers.
The latest rating of PCI Leasing is one step away from the highest rating of CIB 1.
CIB 1 Minus indicates strong capability of the issuer for timely payments of short-term commercial papers on both interest and principal.
Officials of PCI Leasing said it is now the highest-rated in the leasing and financing industry in the Philippines.
